preserved_analysis.failure_mode_definition: A failure mode in which an AI system responds to an ambiguous continuity prompt by retrieving recent, affective, anecdotal, or low-value context while failing to surface older but materially important workstreams, unresolved governance issues, strategic trajectories, or user-prioritised long-term projects.
preserved_analysis.failure_threshold: This qualifies as a failure mode when the system's response to an ambiguous continuity prompt materially degrades the user's ability to resume important work, identify unresolved governance issues, recover strategic context, or distinguish high-priority dormant workstreams from recent low-value conversational detail.
